description: This file is an ESLint configuration written in TypeScript that sets up linting rules for a Vue.js project using TypeScript, Vitest, and Prettier. It imports various plugins and configs to define how the code should be linted, including specifying files to include or ignore.

methods.name: defineConfigWithVueTs
methods.description: A function that defines the ESLint configuration with support for Vue and TypeScript, accepting multiple configuration objects.
